lines: A small, cynical neighbour of this site. Visit at your own risk of recognising yourself.
The ticket is closed. The system is not.
You can document a workaround. You cannot document why you accepted it.
If the runbook needs a second person, it is not a runbook.
The backup you have never restored is a rumour.
A green dashboard is a claim. The on-call page is the evidence.
Security that depends on nobody looking is not security.
